correctness.rationale: Expand (A+εB)^d modulo ε². For ordered Jordan blocks of sizes a,b≤d, a corner matrix unit generates the rectangular space under the two independent shifts, so the differential is multiplication by F=Σ x^i y^(d−1−i) in k[x,y]/(x^a,y^b). The relation (x−y)F=0 reduces all degree-t multiples to x^tF; a term survives exactly when d−b≤i≤a−1−t. Consequently there are max(0,a+b−d) independent nonzero products of different degrees, with no characteristic cancellations. Thus the lift count is q^(n²−r_d). The reduction orbit has size |GL_n| divided by the centralizer unit count: the endomorphism space has dimension Σ m_a m_b min(a,b) and its semisimple quotient is the product of matrix algebras of sizes m_s. Combining yields exactly the claimed coefficients. The n=0 convention works; partition substitution also verifies all four small totals.
residual_risks: Uploaded checks not executed; their finite prime-field cases cannot certify extension fields or all exponents. The symbolic argument is the basis of PASS.
